name: Reset Clock
summary: Know at a glance how long until the daily and weekly reset, and set a quick timer that rings in chat when it runs out.
logoPrompt: A round brass stopwatch with a glowing blue clock face and a small circular arrow wrapped around its crown

cover.tagline: Never guess when the reset comes.
bullets: A timer with a label and sound

description: **Reset Clock tells you how long it is until the daily and the weekly reset, and gives you a simple timer for everything else.**
- Countdowns to the daily and the weekly reset of your region.
- A timer with an optional label, from a few seconds up to 24 hours.
- When the timer runs out: a line in chat, a raid warning on screen and a sound.
- A running timer keeps going through a reload or a logout.
- A small movable window with both countdowns and the timer, updated every second.

Type `/resetclock` to see both countdowns. `/resetclock timer 10m tea` starts a timer, `/resetclock timer` shows the time left, `/resetclock cancel` stops it and `/resetclock window` opens or closes the window.
- One timer runs at a time; a new one replaces it. It is shared by all your characters.
- A timer that ran out while you were offline is reported at your next login.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
